arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'dvc/repo/destroy.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('dvc.repo.destroy')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
print('binding_ok')
import os, subprocess, tempfile
from dvc.repo import Repo
tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='dvcdestroy')
subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', tmp], check=True)
subprocess.run(['git', '-C', tmp, 'config', 'user.email', 't@t'], check=True)
subprocess.run(['git', '-C', tmp, 'config', 'user.name', 't'], check=True)
repo = Repo.init(tmp)
open(os.path.join(tmp, 'data'), 'w').write('x')
open(os.path.join(tmp, 'data.dvc'), 'w').write('outs: []\n')
assert os.path.exists(os.path.join(tmp, '.dvcignore')), 'usage needs a dvcignore artifact'
repo.destroy()
assert not os.path.exists(os.path.join(tmp, '.dvc')), 'release destroy must remove the dvc dir'
assert not os.path.exists(os.path.join(tmp, '.dvcignore')), 'release destroy must remove the dvcignore file'
assert not os.path.exists(os.path.join(tmp, 'data.dvc')), 'release destroy must destroy stages'
print('destroy_ok')
